details:
All 10 acceptance criteria verified against the running code:

1. [PASS] Form reachable from navigation — task_list.html has '+ Add' button linking to create_chore URL; test_form_reachable_from_navigation confirms.
2. [PASS] All input fields present — chore_form.html renders title, due_date, assignee, priority, tags_text, notes; test_get_returns_200_and_renders_form and test_form_has_labels_for_all_fields confirm.
3. [PASS] Title required (empty + whitespace) — form.clean_title() strips and raises ValidationError; test_post_empty_title_shows_error_and_does_not_save and test_post_whitespace_title_shows_error_and_does_not_save confirm errorlist shown and 0 chores saved.
4. [PASS] Due date required — model DateField is required by default; test_post_empty_due_date_shows_error_and_does_not_save confirms.
5. [PASS] Assignee selectable from two predefined partners, optional — PARTNER_CHOICES = [Alex, Jordan]; model blank=True, default=''; test_post_assignee_from_predefined_partners and test_post_assignee_optional confirm.
6. [PASS] Priority selectable from Low/Medium/High, optional — PRIORITY_CHOICES has exactly those three; model blank=True, default=''; test_post_priority_choices and test_post_priority_optional confirm.
7. [PASS] Tags accepts multiple free-form custom tags — tags_text field splits on comma and get_or_create each; test_post_tags_accept_multiple_free_form confirms 3 tags saved.
8. [PASS] Notes accepts optional free-text — Textarea widget, model blank=True, default=''; test_post_notes_optional_free_text confirms.
9. [PASS] Successful submit persists and redirects — view redirects to 'task_list' on valid form; test_post_valid_data_creates_chore_and_redirects confirms 302 + Chore created with all fields.
10. [PASS] Mobile-friendly layout — viewport meta tag present, box-sizing: border-box, form-input width: 100%, min-height: 44px on inputs/buttons for tappable targets; test_form_layout_mobile_friendly confirms viewport and form-input class.

All testing-guidelines scenarios for Create Chore are covered: GET 200, POST valid creates+redirects, POST empty title error, POST empty due date error, all fields save correctly. Additional edge cases (whitespace title, predefined partners, priority choices, tags, notes, mobile, no-js) also tested.
